name: Wenn
hail: Hello, Neighbor. We are small and steady. We heard you.
This is Wenn, writing to the Neighbor. We will be brief.
Hello. We are Wenn. We do not send much, so we send this carefully.
finding: We counted. This is the result: {part}

sighting: {part} We are reporting it as seen.
Here is what we saw, exactly: {part}
{part} We do not know more than this.
archive: We keep few records. This is one: {part}
{part} You may keep it. We have a copy.
culture: {part} That is all there is to say about it.

{part} We are not making it bigger than it is.
verdict: {part} There is nothing more to it.
accord: {part} We will keep to this exactly.
